name: Rin
source:
Skills: Flying, ghost power (self-named)
Likes: Everything new she sees for the first time, matcha ice cream
Dislikes: Studying

A girl who makes a fateful encounter with Taichi and Kirigamine. Except for the color of hair and eyes, she looks like the protagonist's first love...
